hooks.text: 按神话时间顺序经历赫拉克勒斯十二试炼、金羊毛与特洛伊木马
hooks.excerpt: In the game, you will experience the classical stories of "Twelve trials of Hercules", "Searching for Golden Fleece", "Trojan Horse" one by one according to historical time sequence, and eventually control the power of monsters, heroes, gods and magic to create a new world.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 六百余角色同场作战，碰撞、轻重推挤、弹道与状态伤害共同参与战斗演算
hooks.excerpt: (1) Battle Scene: Support more than 600 characters. (2) Physical Engine: Unit Collision, heavy push light, ballistic collision calculations, predominant overhead shooting, etc. (3) Real Combat: Characters have been burned, poisoned, frozen, fallen and other manifestations, some monsters will have "broken limbs".
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 近百张英雄、怪物与神祇卡牌，通过职业卡和中立卡搭配出不同战术
hooks.excerpt: (6) Classic Characters: There are nearly 100 cards, including classic heroes: Achilles, Hercules, Perseus; classic monsters: Medusa, Sea monster, Hydra; and Athena, Apollo, Ares, Prometheus, Hades, Zeus and other famous Gods.You can collocation out of a variety of tactics through professional card + neutral card .
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
